title: Google Maps reviews
description: Three row types share one dataset: review (one review, charged), place (listed total, histogram, completeness verdict and trend for a place, free) and status (one per input line, free).

dataset.title: Google Maps reviews
dataset.description: One row per review, plus one place row and one status row per place. Review rows are billed as delivered; place and status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its filtered, already-seen, duplicate and error tallies, and its HTTP stats.
